description: Cuts the subject out of a picture in the design (a person, a product, a pet): Paletoo’s own Select subject runs on the person’s device in their open editor, free, and masks the background away — nothing is deleted, the mask can be turned off. Use it for «remove the background of the photo», «cut out the product». Example: { design, layer: «<picture id>» }.

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

layer.description: a picture’s id from get_design; none: the biggest photo

name: remove_background
title: Remove a background
